family_reports.body: I can’t put into words the way I feel or what it’s done. I’m a completely different person who feels like I can’t even be myself because it’ll be used against me, so I try to stay quiet and hold back even joking with family and friends.

The family court system in Texas caused profound harm to our family. We have experienced 8 years of emotional exhaustion, financial strain, fear, and helplessness, while trying to raise concerns that were important to our child’s well-being. When families feel that evidence is ignored and decision-makers are not accountable for their actions, trust in the system is deeply damaged. Please reach out to us if you’ve had the same experience in Dallas/Collin County Texas.

I was threatened before I ever got into court. It started the second we separated. I was immediately moved out of my home and impoverished. I had to sign off everything and my ex was given 100% of the assets, or my children and I would be harmed.
Exploited my family for money . Follow the money. Abused my baby severely, giving her to a absent dad who only had about 45 day visitation her whole life . She was taken at age 5

This has torn our family down financially medically and emotionally it’s been very traumatic the most traumatic thing any one of us has ever experienced in our life time because it’s an entire system and we’ve asked for help from the bottom all the way up to the top and shown proof of innocent children in danger of losing their live’s and it’s ignored while other stories emerge mirroring our’s where time expired and another child, parent, or family member succumbed to this torture and abuse by a system that is opposed to protect the people their oaths were taken in officials were sworn in promising to protect and serve us knowing full well their intentions were to increase their bank accounts and line their pockets with the blood and lost lives of innocent little children and families of their own communities and they sleep peacefully while doing this and post all over social media how they get to spend those precious moments with their loved ones spending our money doing it.
